# cmgdr

A small, low-level R client for the public curatedMetagenomicData (cMD)
data releases at <https://cmgd-public.cancerdatasci.org>. It is for the
cMD team and anyone who wants the published profiles quickly: find a
release, list its tables and studies, download verified files, read
per-study files, build a species `TreeSummarizedExperiment`, or attach
the whole release in DuckDB and query it with SQL or dplyr.

It only knows the published layout (JSON indexes, Parquet, TSV and a
read-only DuckLake catalog). Higher-level tooling can build on it.

## Install

cmgdr is being prepared for Bioconductor. Until it is accepted, install
it from GitHub:

``` r

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("seandavi/cmgdr")
```

Once it is on Bioconductor:

``` r

BiocManager::install("cmgdr")
```

This installs duckdb (1.5.4.1 or newer) and DBI for
[`cmgd_connect()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_connect.md)
and reading Parquet files, and TreeSummarizedExperiment for
[`cmgd_species_tse()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_species_tse.md).
Install `dplyr` and `dbplyr` too to query attached tables with dplyr.

## Quick start

``` r

library(cmgdr)

cmgd_datasets()                      # published datasets and their latest release
rel <- cmgd_release("cmgd_mpa4.2-2.3.0")   # latest release of that dataset
rel

cmgd_tables(rel)                     # tables, row counts, licence
cmgd_studies(rel)                    # studies and sample counts

# Per-study files: downloaded once into a checksum-verified cache
qc <- cmgd_read_study(rel, "ZellerG_2014", "qc")
tse <- cmgd_species_tse(rel, "ZellerG_2014")   # species x samples, sparse

# Pick samples by metadata, across studies, then one TSE for them
meta <- cmgd_sample_metadata(rel, wide = TRUE)   # one row per sample
tse <- cmgd_samples_tse(rel, meta[meta$health_condition %in% "case", ])

# The whole release in DuckDB, nothing downloaded up front
con <- cmgd_connect(rel)
DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT study_name, count(*) AS n FROM qc_metrics GROUP BY 1")
dplyr::tbl(con, "taxonomic_profile_metaphlan")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

# HUMAnN gene families, one file per sample. Optional outputs such as gene
# families exist only in releases whose run produced them; on other releases
# cmgd_genefamilies() stops with "has no gene families". Check what a release
# carries with cmgd_index(rel, "studies/index.json")$artifacts.
gf_rel <- cmgd_release("cmgd_humann3.9-2.3.0")
cmgd_genefamilies(gf_rel)            # studies with gene families
gf <- cmgd_genefamilies(gf_rel, study = "ZellerG_2014")   # fetches only that study's index
cmgd_download(gf_rel, gf$url[1])
```

See
[`vignette("cmgdr")`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/articles/cmgdr.md)
for a walk through, and the publisher’s consumer guide
(`docs/data-access.md` in seandavi/nextflow_telemetry) for what every
table and column holds.

## What it reads

``` text
https://cmgd-public.cancerdatasci.org/index.json   every dataset, latest release
https://cmgd-public.cancerdatasci.org/<dataset>/
  latest.json, releases.json
  <release>/manifest.json, catalog.ducklake
  <release>/tables/<table>/files.json, schema.json, data/*.parquet
  <release>/studies/index.json, studies/<study>/...
  <release>/genefamilies/index.json, <study>.json   -> files on https://cmgd-raw.cancerdatasci.org
```

A dataset is one pipeline registration, named `<workflow_id>-<version>`
(`cmgd_mpa4.2-2.3.0`, `cmgd_nextflow-2.2.1`, …). A release is an
immutable snapshot named by its build date (`2026-10-08`). Neither site
can be listed; everything is found through the JSON indexes. cmgdr
refuses a manifest whose publication spec major version (cdsci-lake, 2)
or a cmgd index whose `spec_version` major (cmgd index spec, 1) it does
not know.

Downloads go to `tools::R_user_dir("cmgdr", "cache")` (see
[`cmgd_cache_dir()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_cache_dir.md)),
are checked against the indexes’ size and SHA-256 and are not fetched
again while the cached copy verifies. The per-study gene-family indexes
are verified against `genefamilies/index.json`, which is verified
against `studies/index.json`.

## Development

Install the package’s dependencies, including the Suggests the tests and
vignette need (`webfakes`, `dbplyr`, `quarto`, …), then run the tests.
No credentials or network are needed: the tests serve a local fixture
site.

``` r

pak::local_install_dev_deps()
testthat::test_local()   # or R CMD check
```

Code follows the tidyverse style with 4-space indents and lines of at
most 80 characters (Bioconductor’s style). A
[pre-commit](https://pre-commit.com) hook runs styler on staged R files;
enable it once per clone with

``` sh
pip install pre-commit
pre-commit install
```

## Conformance

The tests run against a small fixture release, shipped as one archive
(`tests/testthat/fixtures/site.tar.gz`), generated by the publisher’s
own code (`data-raw/make_fixture.sh`, which records the
nextflow_telemetry commit it came from), unpacked under
[`tempdir()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/tempfile.html) and served over
local HTTP with Range support. **The fixture is the contract**: when the
release layout changes, regenerate it and fix whatever breaks.

# Package index

## Find a release

- [`cmgd_datasets()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_datasets.md)
  : Published cMD datasets
- [`cmgd_releases()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_releases.md)
  : Releases of a dataset
- [`cmgd_release()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_release.md)
  : Open a release
- [`cmgd_provenance()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_provenance.md)
  : Provenance of a release

## Tables and files

- [`cmgd_tables()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_tables.md)
  : Tables in a release
- [`cmgd_files()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_files.md)
  : Data files of release tables
- [`cmgd_download()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_download.md)
  : Download a release file, verified and cached
- [`cmgd_cache_dir()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_cache_dir.md)
  : cmgdr's download cache directory
- [`cmgd_connect()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_connect.md)
  : Attach a release's tables in DuckDB

## Studies

- [`cmgd_studies()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_studies.md)
  : Studies in a release
- [`cmgd_study_files()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_study_files.md)
  : Per-study download files
- [`cmgd_read_study()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_read_study.md)
  : Read a per-study file
- [`cmgd_species_tse()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_species_tse.md)
  : A study's species profile as a TreeSummarizedExperiment

## Sample metadata

- [`cmgd_sample_metadata()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_sample_metadata.md)
  : Sample metadata tables
- [`cmgd_find_runs()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_find_runs.md)
  : Find samples by run accession
- [`cmgd_samples_tse()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_samples_tse.md)
  : Species profiles of any samples as a TreeSummarizedExperiment

## Gene families

- [`cmgd_genefamilies()`](https://seandavi.github.io/cmgdr/reference/cmgd_genefamilies.md)
  : HUMAnN gene-family files
